[[Baine Bloodhoof|Baine]] (son) }} '''Cairne Bloodhoof''' is the High Chieftain of the united tribes of the tauren, chieftain of the Bloodhoof and leader of Thunder Bluff. Allying with the Horde upon its arrival on the shores of Kalimdor, Cairne stands as one of its wisest and most venerated leaders. ==Quests== * {{questlong|Horde|10|A Hunt for Honor}} {{questfinish}} * {{questlong|Horde|10|Journey into Thunder Bluff}} {{questfinish}} * {{questlong|Horde|14|Rites of the Earthmother}} {{queststartfinish}} * {{questlong|Horde|28|Rumors of the Deathtotem}} {{questfinish}} * {{questlong|Horde|28|Uncovering the Rumors}} {{queststart}} * {{questlong|Horde|28|Information for Cairne}} {{questfinish}} * {{questlong|Horde|28D|Destroy the Deathtotem}} {{queststartfinish}} * {{questlong|Horde|56|Father Will Listen}} {{questfinish}} * {{questlong|Horde|56|Bloodhoof Stands with Moonhoof}} {{queststart}} * {{questlong|Horde|60|The Feast of Winter Veil (Horde)|The Feast of Winter Veil}} ([[Feast of Winter Veil]]) {{questfinish}} ==Quotes== ===Gossip=== Greetings young one, and welcome to Thunder Bluff. You'll find safe refuge from the burdens of the world here. All denizens of the Horde are welcome here. The spirits of the present and past come alive here in this sacred place, my friend. Honor them, and in doing so honor yourself. ===Greetings=== *We Tauren have always held a great respect for the ways of the Earthmother. *I am Cairne, chief of the Bloodhoof Tauren. *Take heart young one, the Earthmother is near. *Ish-ne-alo por-ah, may the Earthmother smile upon you. ===Combat=== ;Aggro *Ishne'alo'porah! *For honor! ;Raid wipe *The attackers have fled!
